info.name: Python Echo API
info.description:
A Flask-based HTTP echo service that mirrors request data back to the client. Useful for testing HTTP clients and debugging API requests.

Based on the httpbin pattern, this API provides endpoints for:
- Request inspection (headers, query params, body)
- HTTP method testing (GET, POST, PUT)
- Status code simulation
- Response header manipulation
